name: François Boucher

summary.text: François Boucher was a French painter, draughtsman and etcher, who worked in the Rococo style. Boucher is known for his idyllic and voluptuous paintings on classical themes, decorative allegories, and pastoral scenes.
summary.title: François Boucher

1131176: The Blonde Odalisque, or Resting Girl, are two oil-on-canvas paintings by the French painter François Boucher. The paintings feature a naked woman on her stomach on a couch.
3211033: The Birth of Venus is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French Rococo artist François Boucher, created c. 1750–1770. It is held in the Wallace Collection, in London, England.
3223900: The Rising of the Sun is a 1752 oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist François Boucher. It and its pair The Setting of the Sun were both private commissions for Madame de Pompadour as full-scale models for the Gobelins Manufactory.
3227830: The Triumph of Venus is a 1740 oil-on-canvas painting in Rococo style by the French artist François Boucher. It inspired The Birth of Venus by Jean-Honoré Fragonard.
3548343: Pastoral with a Couple near a Fountain or An Autumn Pastoral is an oil on canvas painting by the French Rococo artist François Boucher, created in 1749. It is held in the Wallace Collection, in London.
Pastoral with a Couple near a Fountain
3556817: Diana Bathing or Diana Getting out of her Bath is an oil-on-canvas painting by French artist François Boucher, created in 1742. It depicts the Roman goddess Diana, with a nymph as her companion.
3796075: The Setting of the Sun is a 1752 oil-on-canvas painting by the French painter François Boucher. It and its pair The Rising of the Sun were both private commissions for Madame de Pompadour as full-scale models for the Gobelins Manufactory.
11345762: Jupiter and Callisto is a 1744 oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist François Boucher, now in the Pushkin Museum in Moscow. It shows Jupiter disguised as Diana to seduce Callisto.
12860070: Venus Consoling Love is an oil-on-canvas painting executed in 1751 by the French artist François Boucher. The painting depicts a mythological scene, where Venus, the goddess of Love, depicted as a charming and supple young woman, is impersonating the French Rococo's beauty ideals.
12900239: Hercules and Omphale is an oil-on-canvas painting by French painter François Boucher, likely completed sometime between 1731 and 1734. The painting depicts the mythological romance between the Greek hero Hercules and Omphale, queen of Lydia.
15934578: Vulcan Presenting Venus with Arms for Aeneas, also known as Venus at Vulcan's Forge, is an oil-on-canvas painting by the French painter François Boucher, executed in 1757. He produced it as the basis for one work in a series of four tapestries devoted to "the loves of the gods" for King Louis XV.
Vulcan Presenting Venus with Arms for Aeneas (Boucher)
16038677: Landscape Near Beauvais is an oil-on-canvas painting by François Boucher, dated to the 1740s and now in the Hermitage Museum in St Petersburg.
18552705: Portrait of Madame de Pompadour is a 1759 oil-on-canvas painting by the French Rococo artist François Boucher, now in the Wallace Collection in London. It was the last of a series of seven portraits by the artist of Madame de Pompadour.
18783512: The Brunette Odalisque is a 1745 oil-on-canvas painting by French artist François Boucher, now in the Louvre in Paris. The painter's signature is engraved on the low table.
19911802: The Toilet of Venus is an oil painting on canvas completed in 1751 by the French Rococo painter François Boucher. It was commissioned by Madame de Pompadour, for her shared retreat with her lover, King Louis XV.
19947558: The Light of the World is a 1750 oil-on-canvas painting by the French artist François Boucher, currently housed in the Musée des beaux-arts de Lyon. Commissioned by Madame de Pompadour, the chief mistress of King Louis XV, it marked Boucher's first major foray into religious subject matter.
23011437: Fishing is a painting executed in 1757 by the French Rococo artist François Boucher.
26493319: Landscape with a Watermill is a 1755 landscape painting by the French artist François Boucher. It features a picturesque view of an old watermill near a bridge.
28110223: Diana Returning from the Hunt, also referred to as Nymphs Reposing from the Chase, is an 18th-century oil painting by the French Rococo artist François Boucher.
28495558: Jupiter and Callisto or The Nymph Callisto Seduced by Jupiter in the Guise of Diana is a 1759 oil painting on canvas by the French Rococo painter François Boucher, now in the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art in Kansas City, United States.
63536638: Aurora and Cephalus is a 1733 oil-on-canvas painting by François Boucher, signed by the artist and now in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Nancy. It shows Cephalus and Aurora from Book VII of Ovid's Metamorphoses.
70781027: Pompadour at Her Toilette is an oil-on-canvas painting by François Boucher from 1750 depicting Madame de Pompadour, the mistress of King Louis XV of France.
83742686: Lovers in a Park is a 1758 oil painting on canvas by the French artist François Boucher. It is in the Timken Museum of Art, in San Diego.
110304528: The Judgement of Paris is an oil-on-canvas mythological painting by the French Rococo artist François Boucher. It was painted c. 1763 and belongs to the Musée des Beaux-Arts of Mulhouse, France.
